title: 显示Loading
problem_statement_md:
在许多应用程序和网站中，通常都会有加载提示函数`showPreloader()`。

完善并调用该函数，将 "Loading" 输出到控制台。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]User-Defined Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

It’s very common to have "Preloader" component, especially in multifunctional apps and websites.
Create a function that will output "Loading" to the console.

[b]Output[/b]
Loading

[note]Don't forget to call the function.[/note]
